title: Qt: Welcome Banner implementation
description:
This implements a welcome banner that is better integrated into
the welcome page. Additionally it integrates the update
functionality and informs better about new versions without
being too intrusive for the user

Implements #21169
Implements #14792

AI-Assisted: yes (Claude)

notes.body:
This version MUST not be merged. There are two issues:
- The version of the update is fixed to support testing
- Resizing the mainWindow leads to display issues (the sidebar not collapsing correctly) which needs to be fixed

added 3 commits
  • 0d53a312 - Qt: Move LearnCardWidget to stylesheets
  • eee27d23 - Qt: Fixing resizing issues
  • e9a7e75d - Qt: Move Interface Section on the welcome page to widget
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/24283/diffs?diff_id=1743316025&start_sha=41ce18f410c70d28390d2456fa5d79ced7d45495)
This will also be split up into smaller changes. Just putting it here if someone wants to test it already.

added 9 commits
  • e9a7e75d...a4da116b - 6 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • 19c4e8d7 - Qt: Move capture interface selection to own widget
  • ec203005 - Qt: Enable smaller sizes for the MainWindow
  • 3b2dc82b - Qt: Add a welcomepage banner that also handles update
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/24283/diffs?diff_id=1744883404&start_sha=e9a7e75d6f942e07e0f2eae21bbd59f485a7fe24)
